name: axiom_fire_event
description: Fire a new event into Axiom for processing by event subscriptions and workflows.

name: axiom_list_subjects
description: List existing Axiom subjects with optional filtering by name, labels, and ref. Each result includes an active flag (true if the subject has a running or waiting workflow run).

parameters.name: filterName
parameters.description: Filter by subject name or issue ref (substring match)

parameters.name: filterRef
parameters.description: Exact-match filter on the subject reference

name: axiom_get_subject
description: Get details of a specific Axiom subject including metadata, reference, and whether it is active (has a running or waiting workflow run).

name: axiom_get_task_status
description: Get the status and details of a specific task on a subject.

name: axiom_add_thread_entry
description: Post an update or message to a subject's conversation thread.

name: axiom_add_subject_label
description: Add a label to an Axiom subject for categorization and filtering.

name: axiom_remove_subject_label
description: Remove a label from an Axiom subject.

name: axiom_list_tools
description: List all custom tool definitions configured in Axiom.

parameters.name: filterName
parameters.description: Filter by tool name or description (substring match)

name: axiom_get_subject_thread
description: Read the conversation thread for a subject.

name: axiom_list_action_types
description: List all action types configured in Axiom. Action types run only from workflow action nodes; they cannot be invoked directly.

parameters.name: filterName
parameters.description: Filter by action type name (substring match)

name: axiom_list_agents
description: List all agents configured in Axiom.

name: axiom_update_subject
description: Update an Axiom subject's metadata such as name, body, or labels.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of labels to set on the subject

name: axiom_update_subject_body
description: Update an Axiom subject's body with markdown content.

name: axiom_list_events
description: List events related to an Axiom subject.

name: axiom_respond_to_task
description: Submit a response to a task that is waiting for human input.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: The task ID awaiting a response

name: axiom_create_subject
description: Create a new Axiom subject programmatically.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Optional JSON object of key-value metadata

name: axiom_get_activity_log
description: Get the global activity log, optionally filtered by subject.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default 50)
